title: Onboarding input is never consumed, so the same key/click is double-handled by RunView (click starts a phantom drag, SPACE re-toggles pause)
location: hud.gd:49-57 (dismiss); run_view.gd:189-194 (click->drag), :221 (SPACE->toggle_pause); no set_input_as_handled in scripts/run/
detail: HUD dismisses onboarding on any key/click but never marks the event handled, so RunView's _unhandled_input also acts on it: a left-click near a node starts a drag, and SPACE re-toggles pause after HUD just unpaused (may leave the sim paused).
recommended_fix: Call get_viewport().set_input_as_handled() in the HUD onboarding-dismiss branch (and the end-overlay R path) so RunView does not also process overlay input.
